question: Why did Memukan say that Vashti's refusal was a wrong against more than just the king?
options: She had broken a law of the temple
She had insulted a foreign guest
Her conduct would become known to all women and cause them to despise their husbands
She had stolen from the royal treasury
explanation: Memukan said the queen's conduct would become known to all the women, who would then despise their own husbands.
